scripts.render:build: npm ci --include=dev && npm rebuild sqlite3 --build-from-source && npm run build
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "$connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }; Write-Host 'Stopped server on port 3000.' } else { Write-Host 'No server running on port 3000.' }"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.mjs
scripts.dev:all: start powershell -NoExit -Command npm start && start powershell -NoExit -Command npm run dev:client
scripts.stop:client: powershell -Command "$connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }; Write-Host 'Stopped frontend dev server on port 5173.' } else { Write-Host 'No frontend dev server running on port 5173.' }"
scripts.restart:client: npm run stop:client && npm run dev:client
scripts.stop:all: npm run stop && npm run stop:client
scripts.restart:all: npm run stop:all && start powershell -NoExit -Command npm start && start powershell -NoExit -Command npm run dev:client
